message.content: Based on the discussion, Dyllan provides insight into the combat system in "Horizon Forbidden West." Specifically, Dyllan mentions that the combat can be challenging, particularly when dealing with flying machines. To manage these aerial threats effectively, Dyllan suggests using a bow equipped with elemental arrows, which can stun the flying machines, allowing for easier defeat. Additionally, Dyllan emphasizes the importance of using the control center to track the movements of the enemy, which aids in avoiding attacks. This detailed approach indicates that the combat in "Horizon Forbidden West" requires careful planning and precise execution to succeed.
